title: Director - Dragonfly VPP Business Development
description:
**Clustered Virtual Power Plants for AI Data Centers**

sonnen is one of the pioneers of the virtual power plant (VPP). It links thousands of home and small business batteries together so they work as one, supporting the grid and cutting the need for new power lines, substations and power plants. The company started in Germany and now has a fast-growing US business, with its headquarters and factory in Stone Mountain, Georgia.

Project Dragonfly brings this technology to AI data centers, by way of a highly unique local cluster VPP design, where sonnen energy storage systems are installed in thousands (min) of homes and businesses which co-habitat in the same grid load pocket as an AI data center. sonnen can dispatch the VPP as a single local pooled resource or “swarm response,” sculpting the ideal load shape, and balancing the grid. The Dragonfly VPP is designed to save the data center substantial time and money during the interconnection process, by preventing costly grid upgrades, like a new substation, and eliminating prolonged processes for interconnection approval due to certain peak load profiles. The Dragonfly VPP can also reduce or eliminate the data center’s requirement for building new onsite power generation facilities, whether that be natural gas or costly nuclear power. Furthermore, the load flexibility empowered by the VPP will further reduce ongoing demand charges, which the data center would incur from the local utility over the years. The data center can further monetize the VPP by dispatching the battery network into the overall energy market or in partnership with the utility - serving the greater energy grid, outside of its local load pocket. But perhaps the greatest Dragonfly VPP benefit of all, is that of positive public relations, providing the local community members with backup power resiliency and peace-of-mind in the face of potential outages, lower electric bills and cleaner energy, all to support the data center’s existence.
